option_relations.rationale: Post-COVID-19 Reactive Arthritis is a form of reactive arthritis following COVID-19 infection. The provided leaf is 'Vaccination-related Arthritis', which is a distinct etiology for arthritis.
Osteoarthritis is a degenerative joint disease. 'Vaccination-related Arthritis' is an inflammatory condition with a different etiology.

Reactive arthritis (post-viral) is a general category of arthritis following a viral infection. 'Vaccination-related Arthritis' is a specific type of arthritis related to vaccination, not a general post-viral cause, and thus not directly related as a supertype or subtype.

Post-COVID-19 syndrome with osteoarticular and neurological manifestations is a broad syndrome following COVID-19. 'Vaccination-related Arthritis' is a specific type of arthritis related to vaccination, not a general post-COVID syndrome or a manifestation of it.
